name: Messier 16 Listening Party // Dj set
description:
Messier 16 invites you to Brewgata for an exclusive first listen to our third album, Shouts from the Cliffs of Heterodoxy.

Beginning at 23:00, we will present the album in its entirety—from the opening moments of “Nostalgia Theft Reminiscence” to the closing notes of “Trauma Gift Repression”—leading into its official release at midnight.

Join us to hear the record as a complete work, together, on the eve of its release.

Thursday, October 22
23:00
Brewgata, Oslo
Free entry
